sources.title: Law on Foreigners
sources.publisher: Official Gazette of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The Official Gazette publishes the enacted Foreigners Law.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The Government adopts a regulation determining nationalities required to hold visas and those exempt.

sources.title: Annual Work Plan of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade for 2025
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Ministry planning document identifies the proposal and responsible Consular Affairs Directorate.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Proposed regulation determining states whose nationals need visas and those exempt.

sources.title: Information for foreign nationals entering North Macedonia
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The official MFA consular page states current named nationality and document-conditioned entry routes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: EU and Schengen nationals do not need a visa; the UK, US and Canada decision is temporary in 2026.
